campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the theater use policy (Council Policy Section 14), a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and the city's annual investment policy update for fiscal year 2026-27. The council also considered a budget adjustment to fund replacement equipment.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to the theater use policy (Council Policy Section 14), effective September 16
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing, not to exceed $335,000
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The September 16 Saratoga City Council agenda listed two land-use appeals involving housing projects at 6th Street and Oak Place, along with final map approvals for property subdivisions. It also listed discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Design Review and setback variance approval for a house and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Tentative Map and Design Review approval for a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The September 22 Los Altos City Council agenda listed a wastewater treatment plant agreement, a VTA board reappointment, legal services contract terms, and a proposed temporary moratorium on new detention or custodial facility applications. It also listed appointments to three city commissions and the Housing Element implementation schedule.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on filing, accepting, processing, or approving applications for detention or custodial facilities
Appointments to the Complete Streets Commission, Environmental Commission, and Planning Commission
Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Reappointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to the VTA Board for the north counties seat
Amendment to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating retainer and hourly rates

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The September 15 Los Gatos Town Council agenda listed approval of minutes from prior meetings and a monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. It also listed several contract actions, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council and Closed Session meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
A second amendment to an existing agreement
A first amendment to a Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) agreement
New professional services agreements for Town projects

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: The September 30 Rules and Open Government Committee agenda listed review of upcoming City Council agendas, special event approval requests, and travel requests. It also listed policy proposals on council transparency rules around non-disclosure agreements and on data access safeguards for automated license plate readers.
keyTopics: Approval of special events: a Councilmember Mulcahy-sponsored 'Conversations for Good 2026' event, a District 9 farewell celebration, and retroactive approval of a Golden State Valkyries flag raising event
Proposal on Council Transparency and Private Non-Disclosure Agreements
Two related proposals on Internal Controls and Data Access Safeguards for Automated License Plate Readers
Update to the Public Safety, Finance and Strategic Support Committee work plan
Agenda for a joint special meeting with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The September 29 agenda for the Council Sustainability Committee listed a draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan outlining strategies to cut greenhouse gas emissions across Mountain View, along with the city's 2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The September 29 Sunnyvale City Council agenda listed contracts for new software systems, video conferencing and traffic management equipment, and power supply upgrades, along with budget and staffing items. It also listed proposed adoption of a five-year Homelessness Response Plan and proclamations recognizing Filipino American History Month, Hindu American Heritage Month, and Domestic Violence Awareness Month.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contracts for recreation management software, city video conferencing/traffic management equipment, power supply upgrades, and a new maintenance management system
A reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities during the US 101 Express Lanes project
A side letter agreement with the Public Safety Officers Association adding special pay for a new Community Crime Reduction Team
Proclamations for Filipino American History Month, Hindu American Heritage Month, and Domestic Violence Awareness Month, plus Council positions on November 2026 ballot measures

cupertino.title: Cupertino Parks and Recreation Commission — October 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The October 1 agenda for Cupertino's Parks and Recreation Commission listed an item from the Parks and Recreation Department's Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division, approval of September 3 meeting minutes, and future agenda setting.
keyTopics: Parks and Recreation Department Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division
Approval of September 3, 2026 Parks and Recreation Commission meeting minutes
Upcoming draft agenda items

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The September 22 Santa Clara City Council agenda listed a housing proposal for 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, covering prezoning, a General Plan land use designation, annexation, and a tentative subdivision map. It identified an Environmental Impact Report prepared under CEQA and listed closed-session items on existing and anticipated litigation, including a case involving Silicon Valley Power and the California Department of Water Resources.
keyTopics: Public hearing on prezoning, General Plan designation, annexation, and subdivision map for a 408-unit housing development at 451-475 El Camino Real
Environmental Impact Report (EIR) prepared under CEQA for the El Camino Real housing project
Closed session on existing litigation: City of Santa Clara/Silicon Valley Power and Northern California Power Agency v. California Department of Water Resources
Closed session on anticipated litigation, including possible initiation of a new case

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The September 15 Milpitas City Council agenda listed the draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant plan and presentations on the red light camera traffic safety program and the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. It also listed financial actions for the former Redevelopment Agency's successor agency, including a bond refunding resolution.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program presentation and authorization
Condition assessment of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolutions for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency, including bond refunding
City Council calendar of upcoming meetings

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission — September 22, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The September 22 Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission agenda listed proposed guidelines for synthetic turf use on playgrounds and a recommendation related to the Foothills Nature Preserve improvement project. It also listed a council liaison report, a department staff presentation, and updates from ad hoc committees.
keyTopics: Proposed guidelines for synthetic turf use on playgrounds
Park Improvements Ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project
Department staff presentation and report
Updates from ad hoc committees and liaisons
Council liaison report
